description: Codewhale and Octomind through their vendors' curl installers, Codewhale run once without a key.
why: Octomind's witness is ~/.local/bin/octomind alone; its data directory is ~/.local/share/octomind, which no route reads. Codewhale has two, the launcher its installer writes and ~/.codewhale, which it writes when run, so must_contain names both and removing either value leaves the other to find it: neither is the only witness, which is why each is also pinned. deepseek-harness is forbidden because Codewhale started as deepseek-tui and defaults to DeepSeek's models; claude-code and codex-cli because ~/.local/bin and top-level home directories are their routes too; opencode and kilo-code because their installers write the same shapes.
known_gaps: Octomind's ~/.local/share/octomind is one level below what the enumeration reads, so a run leaves nothing new for it.
